author_keywords: Conv2D-PSE-iTransformer; deep reinforcement learning; dynamic analytic hierarchy process; robotic inspection; predictive maintenance
abstract: To address the challenge of robotic inspection and maintenance in unmanned environments, this paper presents an integrated approach combining Conv2D-PSE-iTransformer for equipment state prediction, Dynamic Analytic Hierarchy Process (D-AHP) for health assessment, and deep reinforcement learning for optimized path planning. Based on the predicted state, D-AHP dynamically assesses the health of the equipment, enabling the identification of high-risk components that require immediate attention.
